docs.ts:
/**
   * Recalls a memory pack.
   *
   * `effort: "high"`, `"xhigh"`, or `"max"` needs a lease this package never
   * mints: an embedded client returns `LEASE_REQUIRED`; a remote one gets what
   * the server serves (reranked on its `[models]` reranker, or unreranked and
   * saying so). `effort: "call"` is call mode for live calls: light
   * effort under a hard deadline (`deadlineMs`, or the vault's call-mode
   * deadline), answering with the best results ready, marked `partial`.
   * `media` (`{ space, mime, bytesB64, kinds? }`) is embedded by the server
   * into its declared space; an embedded client returns `MODEL_UNAVAILABLE`.
   * `queryAffect` (`{ valence, arousal, dominance }`: valence in -1..1,
   * arousal and dominance in 0..1) ranks by emotion congruence, embedded and
   * remote alike; out of range it returns `BAD_REQUEST`.
   */
docs.py:
Recalls a memory pack.

        ``effort="high"`` needs a lease this package never mints: an embedded
        client raises ``LEASE_REQUIRED``; a remote one gets what the server
        serves (reranked on its ``[models]`` reranker, or unreranked and
        saying so). ``effort="call"`` is call mode for live calls:
        light effort under a hard deadline (``deadline_ms``, or the vault's
        call-mode deadline), answering with the best results ready, marked
        ``partial``. ``format`` takes the engine's exact tokens:
        ``"json"``, ``"yaml"``, ``"toon"``, ``"md"``, ``"txt"``.
        ``media`` (``{"space", "mime", "bytes_b64", "kinds"}``) is embedded
        by the server into its declared space; an embedded client raises
        ``MODEL_UNAVAILABLE``. ``query_affect`` (``{"valence", "arousal",
        "dominance"}``: valence in -1..1, arousal and dominance in 0..1)
        ranks by emotion congruence, embedded and remote alike; out of range
        it raises ``BAD_REQUEST``.

verbs.name: vault.trusted_contacts.name
verbs.description: The vault owner names another live person of the vault as their trusted contact, reached on one outbound channel verb, with an ask-first dial; naming again replaces it and needs the contact's consent again.

verbs.name: vault.trusted_contacts.list
verbs.description: A live person lists every trusted-contact relation they are a side of: those they named and those naming them, under their own credential.

verbs.name: vault.trusted_contacts.consent
verbs.description: The named contact, a live person under their own credential, accepts the naming version they were shown and attests they are an adult; the relation is live only after this.

verbs.name: vault.trusted_contacts.revoke
verbs.description: Either side of a trusted-contact relation ends it under their own credential; no notice staged from it is sent after this returns, and its open asks close.

verbs.name: vault.trusted_contacts.dial.set
verbs.description: The vault owner changes whether they are asked before their trusted contact is reached (ask_first or just_call); the contact's consent stands.

verbs.name: vault.trusted_contacts.tier.set
verbs.description: The vault owner names the trusted-contact tier (concern or imminent) of one RouteToHelp policy row; a row never named is a concern.

verbs.name: vault.trusted_contacts.concern.asks
verbs.description: The vault owner reads their open asks to reach a trusted contact, each raised by a RouteToHelp the policy gate settled.

verbs.name: vault.trusted_contacts.concern.authorize
verbs.description: The vault owner answers one open ask, once: a yes stages the fact-of-concern notice (staged, not delivered) and returns the notices that tell the person and the model; a no or a superseded ask stages nothing.

verbs.name: vault.guests.mint_slip
verbs.description: The owner mints an ask guest's capability slip, bound to its grant, for the public key the guest generated on their own device.

verbs.name: vault.residence.mode
verbs.description: Switches one of the owner's machines between opened and all residence; that machine's own sync connection applies it. A machine this host does not reach answers state queued, naming the directive.

verbs.name: vault.residence.open
verbs.description: Opens one item on the named machine and reports local or home residence; a NOTE includes typed text, its version and requested stable anchors. A machine this host does not reach answers state queued, naming the directive.

verbs.name: vault.residence.index
verbs.description: The thin index one of the owner's machines holds, window by window: what exists, never a body. A machine this host does not reach answers state queued, naming the directive.

verbs.name: vault.residence.prune
verbs.description: Drops the opened-item caches one of the owner's machines last touched before a time. A machine this host does not reach answers state queued, naming the directive.

verbs.name: vault.off_record.start
verbs.description: The owner enters an off-record session, off record or anonymous, as the owner route does; nothing of it reaches the vault unless the owner promotes or saves it.

verbs.name: vault.off_record.status
verbs.description: The owner reads one live off-record session: its mode, backend, entry time, promoted turns and whether it is closing.

verbs.name: vault.off_record.witness
verbs.description: The owner witnesses one turn into an off-record session; it stays in the room until promoted or dropped at close.

verbs.name: vault.off_record.discard
verbs.description: The owner closes an off-record session without saving it: its turns, writes, receipts and spilled outputs are dropped, and promoted turns stay.

verbs.name: vault.off_record.recall
verbs.description: The owner recalls over an off-record session and the vault together, on their own credential: rows the room holds and vault rows alike.

verbs.name: vault.off_record.notes.create
verbs.description: The owner writes one NOTE into an off-record session through its handle; it lands in the room, never in the vault, and close drops it.

verbs.name: vault.off_record.claims.upsert
verbs.description: The owner admits one claim into an off-record session through its handle and the gate; it lands in the room beside the vault heads, and close drops it.

verbs.name: self.off_record.execute
verbs.description: The owner runs one entry of a durable code-mode run bound to an off-record session; its rows and spilled outputs stay in the room until close.

verbs.name: vault.records.erase_preview
verbs.description: What erasing one record would take: the brief grants it revokes, the records holding the same bytes and the LFS chunks it shares, with the digest erase_confirm takes back.

verbs.name: vault.records.erase_confirm
verbs.description: Erase the record the caller previewed, once its preview still has the digest they confirmed; in a shared vault a held record starts its own erase act instead.

verbs.name: vault.research.create_child
verbs.description: The owner enqueues an experiment child through ordinary agent dispatch under an unpruned campaign parent; record its actual candidate afterward with research.fork or research.weave.

verbs.name: vault.research.archive
verbs.description: Reads the complete retained campaign record, including every pruned, buggy and woven candidate, original search and held-out evidence, selection rounds and promotion receipts, under the controller gate.

verbs.name: vault.evals.inventory
verbs.description: The owner reads the metadata-only eval-authoring inventory: real receipt families, grounded case candidates, date-cut cohorts and exposure counts. Pin its built_at and digest for cohort setup.

verbs.name: vault.evals.cohorts.setup
verbs.description: The owner sets up sealed cohorts from a pinned real inventory through the existing family, case and audited cut doors. Reports refused decisions; never serves sealed content or fabricates labels or skill provenance.

verbs.name: vault.research.bind
verbs.description: Binds an autoresearch campaign to its existing root attempt: its ruler, selection policy, cohort, budget share and prior ladder, once. The owner or the agent running that root calls it.

verbs.name: vault.research.fork
verbs.description: Records a variation or debug child the campaign's controller enqueued under a measured or buggy parent.

verbs.name: vault.research.weave
verbs.description: Records a crossover child of several parents whose candidate landed as a claim through the gate, once a held-out win turned merge crossover on.

verbs.name: vault.research.measure_search
verbs.description: Records a node's search-split evidence, its selection signal, once.

verbs.name: vault.research.measure_held_out
verbs.description: Records a node's held-out evidence, once; only the promotion basis reads it.

verbs.name: vault.research.evaluate_split
verbs.description: The owner scores one arm of a bound claim-authoring campaign on one split under its bound config; the blind taste questions go through the host's decision ladder, and the report is returned, not stored.

verbs.name: vault.research.mark_invalid
verbs.description: Marks a node buggy: it stays as evidence and takes debug children.

verbs.name: vault.research.prune
verbs.description: Stops exploring a branch for a stated cause; its attempts, claims and outputs stay. A stop names the caller.

verbs.name: vault.research.select
verbs.description: Runs one selection round through the trusted selection floor and records it; only the owner can say the goal is met.

verbs.name: vault.research.promotion_basis
verbs.description: Decides a candidate's held-out promotion basis against the incumbent, once.

verbs.name: vault.research.reserve_confirmation
verbs.description: Spends a Promote candidate's one sealed confirmation and releases the campaign's sealed cohort to the controller's referee, counted as a serving.

verbs.name: vault.research.promote
verbs.description: Settles a candidate on the sealed referee's scores of it and the incumbent: a strict win, a not-worse sufficiency card and, for a skill, the gate's accepted verdict make it the incumbent.

verbs.name: vault.research.reserve_work
verbs.description: Reserves token work for the campaign on the RSI line under its share, and returns the reservation's id.

verbs.name: vault.research.settle_work
verbs.description: Settles a work reservation at its actual spend.

verbs.name: vault.research.refund_work
verbs.description: Refunds a work reservation nothing was spent on.

verbs.name: vault.research.record_benchmark
verbs.description: Records an estimator version's held-out selection benchmark against the DGM parent formula, once per version; a win of at least 30 cases lets its information gain rank parents.

verbs.description: Binds one kind slot to a declared space, or returns it to its default when no space is named.

verbs.description: Binds every kind slot the space accepts, text included, to that one space.

verbs.name: vault.embedding_spaces.retire
verbs.description: Drops a declared space that no slot binds and no open move names, with its vector rows.

verbs.description: Starts moving every kind slot the incumbent serves (the text index when none is named) to the candidate space.

verbs.description: Runs an embedding space move probes now through both spaces and acts on the reading; it can take minutes.

verbs.name: vault.embedding_spaces.move_approve
verbs.description: The owner says yes to a full candidate over a check that did not read not worse; it swaps in.

verbs.name: vault.embedding_spaces.move_undo

verbs.name: vault.embedding_spaces.move_abandon

verbs.name: vault.embedding_spaces.probes.list

verbs.name: vault.embedding_spaces.probes.put
verbs.description: Stores one retrieval probe the owner or another model wrote: kind, query, family, targets and author.

verbs.name: vault.embedding_spaces.probes.delete
verbs.description: Removes one stored embedding space probe by its id.

verbs.name: vault.settings.wake_policy.set

verbs.name: vault.settings.inference_defaults
